title: Your Credit Report Has a $47K Error — Check It Free
hook: One in five Americans has an error on their credit report right now — and that invisible mistake could be adding $47,000 to your next mortgage.
angle: Most people know free credit report checks exist but never use them — this shows the exact dollar cost of ignoring it and how to fix it in three minutes for free
audience: Anyone with credit cards, loans, or plans to buy a home — especially 25-45 year-olds actively building credit
key_numbers: 1 in 5 credit reports contain at least one error
A 100-point score drop adds $47,000 to a 30-year mortgage
3 free credit report checks per year — most Americans use zero
